The '''Dragonbane Circuit''' was located in the crystal swamps of the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat]] region on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Unlike the [[Agrilat Swamp Circuit]], the Dragonbane circuit was truly dangerous, for more than one reason. The circuit was among the more obscure [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuits in the region and used by the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] the [[Black Seraphs]], who would frequently organize illegal swoop races on the circuit.

==Description==
The circuit consisted of only six legs, but these were immensely hazardous, passing through razor-sharp crystal grass, crystalline outcroppings, deadfalls, and piles of wreckage. It was not uncommon that local wildlife would venture into the track and attack the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]]. The maximum altitude was only 10 meters.<ref name="SoF" />

The six legs were:
*[[The Long Run]]: long smooth and straight run<ref name="SoF" />
*[[Pillars of the Sky]]: swampy area full of tall trees<ref name="SoF" />
*[[Razor Blades]]: marshland featuring razor sharp blades of crystalline grass<ref name="SoF" />
*[[In a Pinch]]: dangerously narrow crevasse<ref name="SoF" />
*[[The Drop]]: massive drop from a surprisingly tall height<ref name="SoF" />
*[[Reentry]]: another long and smooth run<ref name="SoF" />

==Black Seraph activities==
Few people knew that the Black Seraphs' races were in reality ruses to attract novice racers and rob them of their belongings. Along the circuit, the Black Seraphs had placed several deadly traps that would cripple or kill the racers. Racers that were only wounded by the traps would either be murdered by the Black Seraphs or simply left for dead.<ref name="SoF" />

The leader of the Black Seraphs, [[Sunny Bounder/Legends|Sunny Bounder]], would win most Dragonbane races due to a combination of skill and the dirty tricks of the Black Seraphs. Even if no racers were caught in the traps, the Black Seraphs would still harvest the 200-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] entrance fee that participants in the races had to pay.<ref name="SoF" />
